messages:
maria: PR #412 added a new 'retention scenarios' section to the SOC2 page — includes tenant-migration and per-tenant TTL examples. Need compliance review before merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/412

sanjay: quick skim — question: we use 'TTL' in a few examples (e.g., 'set TTL: 90 days'). Compliance usually prefers 'retention_period' or 'retention_days' wording. :thinking:

maria: good call. I also included a curl + Ruby SDK snippet. @taylor can you verify the SDK example matches the current surface? snippet: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' "https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit/export?scope=tenant&days=90"
```

taylor: on it. FYI the SDK method changed last week — exports.generate no longer accepts `days`, it's `retention_days`. I'll update the snippet and push a tiny commit to the PR branch. also suggest showing redaction flag: `?redact_pii=true`

maria: thanks. Compliance @jessica — any guidance on phrasing like 'we will retain for 90 days' vs 'default retention period is 90 days and can be configured by tenant admins'?

jessica: avoid absolute promises. suggested phrasing: 'Default retention period is 90 days; customers can configure retention for their tenancy. For SOC2 controls, we maintain retention settings and audit trails.' prefer 'is configured to' or 'may be configured' instead of 'will'.

sanjay: also add an anchor to the audit schema doc (/docs/audit-schema.md) and a short note about encryption at rest + KMS reference id.

maria: I'll update copy and snippets. quick q: is it okay to keep `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` in examples or should we redact/placeholder it?

taylor: prefer `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>` to avoid implying a specific env var name.

maria: perfect. I'll push changes later today and ping @docs-ci-bot to run checks.

docs-ci-bot: CI: docs build queued for PR #412 — running linkchecker and snippet tests.

docs-ci-bot: CI: linkchecker found a broken anchor to /docs/audit-schema.md#encryption -> 404. Build failing.

maria: ow — I'll fix the anchor and update the PR.

jessica: LGTm after anchor fix + wording update. please include a short support link for export retention limits and note that customers can request longer retention via support.

maria: :thumbsup: merging after green CI and formal approval from @jessica. will open follow-up issue to add Ruby snippet reflecting exports.generate signature change.
file_notes: Thread about PR coordination for SOC2 retention docs, SDK snippet mismatch, wording guidance from compliance, CI linkchecker failure, follow-up action items.
